requirements.text: Workspace owners and admins can create, name, scope, expire, revoke, and view last use of workspace-bound API keys.
API keys are shown once, stored as hashes, and never returned later.
A versioned API exposes links, pages, analytics, and webhooks with rate limits and audit logs.
Sanctum keys are permanently bound to one workspace and enforce explicit abilities, expiry, and rate limits.
Create endpoints support idempotency keys, stable validation JSON, and cursor pagination where applicable.
API audit logs retain actor, workspace, route, method, status, and time without bodies, destinations, or secrets.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A raw token is displayed exactly once and cannot select any workspace other than its token owner.
Abilities, expiry, rate limits, idempotency, and cross-workspace authorization are enforced consistently.
OpenAPI documentation is generated from the final request and response contracts.

observedBehaviors: The API-key screen shows a tabular list with name and lifecycle columns.
